title: Double Drip Orange & Mango Chill Shortfill E-Liquid 50ml
description: Orange Mango Chill from Double Drip is a deliciously juicy, sweet and refreshing e-liquid, tailor-made for sunny days. The bright, zesty orange flavour plays off juicy, ripe mango to perfection, while an invigorating rush of menthol on the exhale finishes this exquisite e-liquid off to perfection. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength, and typically adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well. We also offer a range of 18mg nicotine-containing e-liquid shots in a variety of VG percentage strengths to ensure you find a perfect match to suit your taste. Double Drip Coil Sauce E-Liquid is a high-quality vape juice brand proudly manufactured right here in the United Kingdom. Browse the entire Double Drip range and find the perfect juice for your e-cigarette setup. Double Drip is available in a variety of formulations to suit a range of kits, including sub ohm (high-VG), 50/50 e-liquid , nicotine salt vape juice , and 50ml shortfills for use with starter vape kits , high-powered e cig kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
